claims.claim: Swish containment is exactly a multiplicity-respecting directed-cycle problem.
claims.evidence: After independently transforming each selected card, orient its arc from hoop to ball. In a nonempty swish every used position has exactly one outgoing and one incoming arc, so each connected component is a directed simple cycle. Conversely, the cards realizing any directed simple cycle satisfy the swish condition. Taking one component shows that a collection contains a swish iff it can realize such a cycle, with each type usable no more often than its physical multiplicity.
claims.search_method: Direct proof from the source definition, supplemented by exact enumeration of the finite transformation system.

claims.claim: A no-swish collection contains at most 20 distinct transformation types, and this is sharp.
claims.evidence: Exact enumeration gives 36 transformation types. Eight are internal to the four position orbits, in counts 3,1,3,1; the other 28 form 14 cross-orbit reversal pairs. Both members of a reversal pair realize a 2-cycle, so at most 14 cross types occur. On either four-position orbit, its three internal types realize a triangle, so at most two occur; either two-position orbit contributes at most one. Hence the bound is 14+2+1+2+1=20. Ordering the orbits and selecting all 14 forward cross types plus a cycle-free 2+1+2+1 internal support attains 20. Any cycle containing a cross arc would strictly increase orbit rank and could not close.
claims.witness: For the order A<B<C<D, take the forward member of each of the 14 cross reversal pairs, any two of the three internal types on A and C, and the unique internal type on B and D, one copy each.
claims.search_method: Enumerated all 132 ordered distinct-position arcs under the four symmetries, all reversal pairs, all 256 internal supports, and realizable labeled directed simple cycles.

claims.claim: Unless all eight internal types are duplicated, the usual once-or-twice interpretation of the 60-card deck already yields a 29-card no-swish subset.
claims.evidence: Let M0 be the physical internal-card count. If any of the eight internal types is not doubled, M0<=15, leaving at least 45 cross cards. Over the 24 orders of the four position orbits, every physical cross card is forward in exactly 12 orders. Some order therefore contains at least ceil((60-M0)/2)>=23 forward cross cards. Adding one copy of each type in the fixed six-card cycle-free internal support gives at least 29 no-swish cards; cross arcs strictly increase orbit rank, so none can belong to a cycle. If the construction is larger than 29, it can be trimmed to 29.
claims.witness: Evaluate the 24 orbit orders, choose one maximizing the number of forward physical cross cards, and combine those cards with the six fixed cycle-free internal cards.
claims.search_method: Enumerated all 24 orbit orders, verified frequency 12 for every cross type, and checked the integer guarantees for M0=8 through 15 as 32,32,31,31,30,30,29,29.

claims.claim: The authorized input omits information essential to deciding the exact commercial-deck target.
claims.evidence: The source supplies the totals of 60 physical cards and 36 symmetry types but no type-by-type commercial multiplicity vector. Two exact once-or-twice vectors consistent with these totals give opposite outcomes. Deck X doubles all eight internal types and both directions in eight cross reversal pairs. Local cycle obstructions bound every no-swish subset by 6+16+6=28, and a forward-order witness attains 28. Deck Y doubles nine forward cross types, all 14 reverse types, and one internal type; two copies of those nine forward types, one copy of the other five forward types, and six safe internal cards form a checked 29-card no-swish subset. Thus the supplied aggregate information cannot determine the actual deck's answer.
claims.witness: The checker prints deterministic 36-entry multiplicity vectors for Deck X and Deck Y and verifies their totals, Deck X's exact maximum 28, and Deck Y's 29-card witness.
claims.search_method: Inspected the authorized source for deck multiplicity information, constructed both exact synthetic vectors, proved Deck X's obstruction bound, and exhaustively searched both proposed witnesses for a realizable directed simple cycle.

target_evidence: The exact target asks for a decision about the fixed original commercial deck: either prove its maximum no-swish size is 28 or exhibit a larger subset from that deck. The draft does neither because the authorized input lacks the deck's type-by-type multiplicities. Its structural classification, conditional 29-card theorem, and demonstration that the supplied aggregates permit opposite answers are correct and material, but do not resolve the requested fixed-deck dichotomy. The final writeup explicitly claims only partial resolution, so claimed_resolution is ACCURATE and not overclaimed.
